name: Vercel Web Design Guidelines
use: Use the fresh-rule review pattern; do not treat a cached checklist as permanent truth.

name: Motion
use: Use for purposeful React/JavaScript animation, gestures and scroll-linked sequences.

name: Lenis
use: Use only when smooth scrolling materially supports the narrative; keep native and reduced-motion fallbacks.

name: React Three Fiber
use: Use for inspectable product/place/object 3D scenes when 3D is a core experience, not decoration.

name: Radix Primitives
use: Use low-level accessible behavior as a foundation, then apply a project-specific visual language.

name: shadcn/ui
use: Use selected primitives, not an undifferentiated card-grid template or copied default theme.

name: Next.js
use: Use built-in image/font optimization and stable dimensions when Next.js matches the project.

name: Lighthouse and Lighthouse CI
use: Use repeatable mobile and desktop audits as release evidence; account for run variance.

name: web-vitals
use: Measure field or realistic lab evidence for LCP, INP and CLS instead of relying on visual intuition.

name: Playwright
use: Verify desktop/mobile framing, interaction, console/network health and nonblank 3D canvases.

name: Anthropic Frontend Design
use: Use the pinned local skill to ground design in the subject, choose one signature element and keep motion purposeful; preserve approved compositions and verify reduced motion.
